utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day to all of you. The hearing is now open. Madam Registrar, could you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-98-32/1-A, the Prosecutor versus Milan Lukic and Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I see that Mr. Milan Lukic is not in the courtroom today. I'm now addressing Mr. Milan Lukic's counsel. Are there any submissions you have to make in this courtroom?

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, as far as I know, Mr. Lukic sent a waiver for his attendance of this Status Conference, and I've been authorised to represent him today. The reason for his absence is obviously a problem regarding transport from the Detention Unit to the Tribunal. On a number of occasions he's already had health problems because the police, the Dutch police, would make him wear glasses, or rather, would blindfold him when transporting him here. And today we have been authorised or I have been authorised to represent him, but next time we shall try to solve this problem, which is becoming a chronic one, in a different way.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Given that Mr. Milan Lukic has waived his right to be present in the courtroom, I agree to proceed in spite of his absence, given the information that you have just provided us with. Mr. Sredoje Lukic, can you hear and follow the proceedings in a language that you understand? THE APPELLANT S. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Please sit down. That's perfect. I would now like to ask the respective parties to introduce themselves. Let's start with the OTP representative, if you please.

utterances.speaker: MR. CROSS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Appearing for the Prosecution, I'm Matthew Cross, together with Mr. Matthias Schuster, and our Case Manager is Colin Nawrot. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Could Defence counsel for Mr. Milan Lukic please introduce themselves.

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. My name is Tomislav Visnjic and I represent Milan Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, counsel. Thank you, counsel. I'm now turning to counsel for Mr. Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DIECKMANN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is Jens Dieckmann representing Sredoje Lukic, together with Ms. Malovic as assigned interpreter for this session. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. This Status Conference has been convened pursuant to Rule 65 bis (B) and (C) of the Rules of Procedure of this Tribunal, according to which a Status Conference must be convened within 120 days of the filing of a notice of appeal and thereafter within 120 days after the last Status Conference. The main objective of convening a Status Conference is to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in relation therein, including the mental and physical condition of that person. The Status Conference being held today is the seventh Status Conference being held as part of the appeal proceedings. The last Status Conference was held on the 8th of July, 2011. It was followed by hearings on appeal on the 14th and 15th of September, 2011. It is our intention to file the appeal judgement prior to the summer court recess 2012. Unfortunately, it is not possible for me to be more precise at this point in time. I'm now addressing Mr. Sredoje Lukic. Could you please inform us of the conditions in the Detention Unit as well as any health problems that may have arisen. THE APPELLANT S. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour, for having given me the floor. There have been no changes since the last Status Conference. Everything is in order.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may sit down. I'm now turning to Milan Lukic's Defence counsel. Are there any concerns that you have that concern the conditions in the Detention Unit or that concern the health of your client? I'm addressing Milan Lukic's Defence counsel.

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Has Milan Lukic expressed any concerns he may have concerning the conditions in the Detention Unit and his health? Could you please try and address that issue.

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I've not had any special contacts with my client with this regard. An hour ago when I arrived in the Netherlands, I was still thinking that he would appear in the courtroom today. Obviously there have been some objective conditions for which he is not here today. From my previous conversations with him, I can tell you that he did not have any particular objections to the conditions of detention or any health concerns.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. And finally I would like to ask the parties whether there are any issues they would like to raise at this point in time. I'm first going to put the question to the OTP representative.

utterances.speaker: MR. CROSS
utterances.text: We have nothing to raise this afternoon, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Does Mr. Milan Lukic's Defence counsel have any issues it would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, there are no particular issues that we wish to raise today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. I'm now turning to Defence counsel for Mr. Sredoje Lukic. Are there any particular issues you would like to raise at this point in time?

utterances.speaker: MR. DIECKMANN
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Your Honours. On behalf of Sredoje Lukic, I can declare that there are no issues to raise this afternoon. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. As I have no other issues to address, I believe that we can close today's hearing. I would like to thank the parties for their participation and I would like to thank the Tribunal staff for their assistance in organising this Status Conference. The hearing is adjourned.
